name: 🍎 Eggs & Apple Slices
tagline: The perfect after-school snack: jammy hard-boiled eggs and crisp apple slices.

items.name: Peanut butter or cheddar for dipping

steps.text: Lower cold eggs into boiling water. Cook 9 minutes for firm-but-creamy yolks.
Move straight to a bowl of ice water for 5 minutes.
Slice the apples and toss with a squeeze of lemon so they don't brown.
Halve the eggs, sprinkle with salt and pepper, and plate with apples.

kid_jobs.job: Squeeze the lemon over the apples

chef_tip: Start eggs in boiling water, not cold: they peel cleanly every time.
make_ahead: Boil a dozen on Sunday; unpeeled eggs keep a week in the fridge.
leftovers: Extra eggs go into the Southwest Black Bean & Egg Salad.

game_plan.what: Boil a dozen; unpeeled eggs keep a week.
Ice bath 5 min. Kids slice apples, toss with lemon.
Peel under running water; halve, salt and pepper.
Plate eggs with the apple slices.
